mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, as lower rates reduce the discount rate applied to equity valuations, increasing present value of future cash flows.
failure_condition: The Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and 5-day SPX returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 5.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises above 5.0% in the last 3 months
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the periods when UNRATE is above 5.0%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in employment growth (PAYEMS) and rise in unemployment (UNRATE) signals a weakening labor market, which reduces consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of the periods when PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS rising), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to higher discount rates and reduced liquidity.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the periods when FEDFUNDS rises > 0.25% in 3 months, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1600 thousand units signals weak consumer demand, which reduces corporate revenue growth and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the periods when HOUST is below 1600.0 thousand units, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in industrial production (INDPRO) above 102.0 (index 2017=100) signals robust economic activity, which supports corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the periods when INDPRO is above 102.0, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of high inflation (CPIAUCSL) and high federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals a monetary tightening environment, which increases real interest rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the periods when CPIAUCSL is above 2.5% year-over-year and FEDFUNDS is above 4.5%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in retail sales (RSAFS) above 680,000 million dollars signals strong consumer spending, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the periods when RSAFS is above 680,000.0 million dollars, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.
